title: The Marro
text: "You want my name. I have none. I have the title. The Marro."

lines.text: "The first who came down, the one who carried our names. We say it still."
"It was longer once. It wore down, the way a step wears down. Marro. Marrow, maybe. The first one would know. The first one is a long time burned."

choices.label: Write it down
choices.reply: Logged: the Marro, from a name, perhaps Marrow. The archive has nobody by that name.

choices.label: Thank them
choices.reply: The Marro nods, as if thanks were a thing you hand over, and takes it.
